titre: Design systems open up to agents, Figma plugs in its MCPs
essentiel: Design systems have a new consumer: AI agents, and documentation becomes the key topic.
Figma announces 20 new MCP partners (Config India) and puts controls on agent actions.
Slim day: few usable posts, and no individual LinkedIn posts surfaced.

syntheses.titre: Design systems are now read by agents too
syntheses.texte: Érica Menin starts from an observation: AI agents are a "not so new" consumer of design systems, and she is beginning to make her own usable by AI. On the Figma side, the new controls on how agents operate and the code layers feature (open beta) point in the same direction: the tool becomes a surface that agents read and manipulate. What matters is the clarity of what you put behind it.

syntheses.titre: Figma expands its MCP ecosystem and sets guardrails for its agents
syntheses.texte: Figma announces 20 new MCP partners at Config India, including Linear, Notion, Mistral, Zed and Microsoft 365 Copilot. A newsletter also notes new controls on how agents operate on the platform, as well as a code layers feature in open beta. The direction is clear: connect Figma to many agent tools, with a governance layer. The real effects (adoption, usage) remain to be seen.

tendances.titre: Design systems are now read by agents too
tendances.texte: Agents are already consumers of design systems. Making documentation and structure usable by AI is becoming a workstream in its own right.

tendances.titre: Figma expands its MCP ecosystem and sets guardrails for its agents
tendances.texte: 20 new MCP partners and new controls on agent actions: Figma is positioning itself as a platform open to agents, with a governance framework.
